first draft of our 3 min (Hudson presenting, i drive the demo):
1. problem: a researcher's thinking is spread across 15 tools; when you come back to an idea you can't find where it came from
2. engelbart: imports your chats, papers and notes and keeps the trail of where each thought came from
3. demo: connect screen → import → click a note → "where did this come from" trail
4. traction: 2 pilots this month (berkeley + cmu), 3rd being recruited
5. ask: pre-seed, closing by demo day

Feedback for Mathetic from today:
• The demo is the pitch. Open with it, not the problem slide.
• "15 tools" is abstract. Name the three tools your pilot actually used.
• You said "pilots" six times and never said what success is. Define it.
• 3:40, over by 40 seconds.
